visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned male creator with styled black hair and a white T-shirt is shown in a medium close-up. His face is covered in a glossy, translucent mask that reflects the bright studio lighting. He points his index finger at his cheek, demonstrating the texture. The background is a soft-focus studio environment with warm ambient lights on shelves. Top-center yellow and white text overlays are present. (2) The creator holds a silver-and-white tube of 'Natura Bissé Diamond Extreme Ice-Lift' towards the camera. He uses his thumb to point at the brand name. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the metallic finish of the product packaging. (3) A close-up shot focuses on his hand as he squeezes a generous amount of clear, pink-tinted gel from the silver tube onto his skin. The gel has a thick, viscous consistency. The background remains the blurred white studio wall. (4) The creator presents a silver pump bottle of 'Natura Bissé Diamond Extreme Serum' to the camera, followed by a white jar of 'Natura Bissé Diamond Extreme' cream. He demonstrates applying the cream to his face with his fingers, massaging it into his cheeks with upward strokes. (5) In a medium shot, he reapplies the translucent mask over the previously applied serum and cream. He uses his fingertips to spread the gel evenly across his forehead and cheeks. Large graphical text overlays '大擠特擠' appear briefly over his hands. (6) A red stopwatch graphic appears on the screen as the creator points to it, indicating a waiting period. He then looks at the camera with the dried mask on, showing a very tight facial expression. (7) He uses both hands to grip the edges of the dried mask near his chin and slowly peels it upwards in a single sheet. Small sparkling 'star' graphics are edited over the frame. His skin underneath appears very bright and radiant. (8) The camera transitions to a retail environment. Several rows of well-lit wooden shelves are filled with various white and silver skincare bottles and jars. A black-and-white '10 10 APOTHECARY' logo appears at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a fast pace, describing the skin-tightening effect of a mask. Upbeat electronic-pop BGM with a clear 4/4 drum machine beat plays consistently in the background. The vocal is crisp and professionally processed with high clarity. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX triggers as the speaker introduces the brand Natura Bissé. The BGM maintains a steady, bright synthesizer melody. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to convey enthusiasm as he describes the 'Plastic Doll' effect on his face. (3) The speaker transitions to a tutorial tone, explaining the layering process of serum and cream before the mask. There are no ambient noises, indicating a studio environment. Short 'Whoosh' sounds accompany rapid visual transitions between products. (4) As the creator peels the mask, a whimsical 'Sparkle' or 'Magic' SFX is heard, coinciding with visual glisten effects. The music swells slightly in volume during this reveal. The speaker's voice remains positive and authoritative throughout. (5) The final segment features the speaker recommending the store 10/10 Apothecary. The vocal concludes with a friendly, inviting tone as the music fades out alongside the store visuals.
